item.title: Moday 1.1.3
item.description:
Moday 1.1.3

  • 新增「检查更新」：菜单栏「Moday → 检查更新…」，或「设置 → 更新」。以后有新版本会自动提示，先看更新说明，点一下即可安装，任务和配对保持不变。
  • 包含 1.1.2 的全部改进：数量任务按单位记时间、提醒事项写回失败时保留本地完成、修改模板不再抹掉今天已完成的事项、连续点按更顺、配对与备份恢复更稳。
  • New: Check for Updates — in the menu bar under “Moday → Check for Updates…”, or Settings → Updates. Future versions are offered automatically: read what’s new, then install with one click; your tasks and pairing stay as they are.
  • Includes everything from 1.1.2: per-unit completion times, local completions kept when a Reminders write fails, template edits no longer erase today’s finished items, smoother rapid taps, sturdier pairing and backup restore.
